description: Execution-agent contract for review fix loop

optional_fields.max_rounds: integer — GOAL_REVIEW_MAX_ROUNDS cap applied at merge
optional_fields.rounds_exhausted: boolean — true when business fix loop exceeded max_rounds
optional_fields.blocker_count: integer — number of blocker issues this round
optional_fields.info_gain: float — blocker reduction ratio vs previous round: (prev - cur) / max(prev, 1)
optional_fields.stagnant_rounds: integer — consecutive rounds with info_gain < threshold
optional_fields.stagnant_blocked: boolean — true when info_gain 熔断 triggered (action=blocked_stagnant)
